items.title: Richard Li’s FWD sets world record with sale of US$318m life insurance policy
items.summary: FWD Private (Bermuda), a unit of Hong Kong-listed FWD Group founded by billionaire Richard Li Tzar-kai, has set a new Guinness World Record by selling a US$318 million life insurance policy, the companies said in separate announcements on Tuesday.

items.title: Lions and tigers are kept legally in Ontario backyards. No one knows how many there are
items.summary: Lions and tigers are among some of the most recognizable and dangerous predators in the world. They're also legal to own in Ontario, where provincial authorities can't say how many are being held in private cages and backyards.
